messages:
maya: Quick sync  we had another late-ingest batch overnight and someone kicked off an ad-hoc recompute that bumped quotas. I think we need a small preflight + preview flow on the console to avoid surprises. Ideas: estimated slot-minutes, peak burst in 15m window, and which routing pools will be hit.
ben: yes. Ops got paged. The current "rows" estimate is useless. If we can show est slot-minutes and an expected burst value in a short window that'd be huge. Also show which model variant (fp16 vs 4-bit) the planner would prefer.
sasha: replay-sim gives good numbers but it's slow and sometimes creates temp read jobs. What about a lightweight planner: sample keys, run routing decision logic, multiply up. Fast and read-only.
maya: exactly. Minimal API: POST /backfills/preview -> read-only, sampling_pct, return {est_rows, est_slot_minutes, peak_burst_15m, routing_summary, confidence_pct, blindspots}. Include a flag: include_fallbacks=true to show cost when quantized/fallback models are used.
jkline: UI: put a Preview button next to Start. Preview opens a modal with 3 panels: Summary numbers, routing map (pools + pct), and a small "Risk" section that explains cache/KV reuse blindspots. Also add a small CTA: Request approval / schedule.
ben: We should also simulate permission checks and enterprise audit. Preview must be gated but also logged. Previews are sensitive because they can reveal tenant routing.
sasha: Also consider a quick "what-if" toggle: run preview assuming preemptible instance class vs reserved. Shows delta. Helps ops pick time windows.
ops-bot: NOTE: deploy backfill-service v2 -> staged (us-west) :rocket:
maya: Proposal for response payload text (console-friendly):
```
{
  "est_rows": "9,400",
  "est_slot_minutes": "120",
  "peak_burst_15m": "2 slots",
  "routing_summary": "gpu-us-1: 68%, gpu-us-spot: 32%",
  "confidence_pct": "+/- 12",
  "blindspots": "prefix-cache reuse, KV-cache warmup not modeled"
}
```
ben: Nice. Make sure numbers include units (slot-minutes) and an explicit time window for the peak burst. Also return the sample rate used so people understand variance.
jkline: For console flow: Preview modal -> button "Request run" that opens scheduler where you can pick start window and whether to run during low-traffic hours. Add a checkbox "also recompute dashboards" with tooltip about downstream load.
maya: Ops-safety ideas: require at least one owner approval for > X slot-minutes or peak_burst > Y; and auto-block if projected burst overlaps with a configured maintenance window.
sasha: We need to update the runbook: backfill_preflight_required = true and add steps for overrides. Also create a small operator endpoint POST /backfills/approve to record who approved and link to audit logs.
ops-bot: INCIDENT: last-night backfill caused ~6m elevated ingest latencies. Runbook updated.
ben: Action list: maya - prototype preview endpoint (sampling), jkline - mock modal and scheduler, sasha - update runbook & approval endpoint, I'll check quota calc libs for sampling support. Target: prototype PR by Wed EOD.
maya: I'll spike a quick PoC that reads metrics-index samples and applies routing heuristics. Will post PR and a short demo gif when ready.
sasha: One more: return a tiny per-pool estimate (slot-minutes per pool) so cost-central can estimate billing impact.
maya: Good call. I'll add pool-level breakdown and a simple cost estimate field (est_credits).
